items.title: Trump’s ‘Golden Age’ Economy Pitch Fizzles With Midterm Voters
items.summary: For most of his second term, President Donald Trump has been arguing that the “golden age” he promised for America’s economy is already here. There’s hardly been much evidence that voters agreed.
